issues_found: Event listeners were registered only for a specific model (Post), making mixin adoption fragile.
Developers had to manually register additional models with the mixin which is error prone.
fixes: Added SearchableMixin.register_listeners(db) to bind listeners to the session class, using isinstance checks.
before_commit/after_commit now collect and operate on all SearchableMixin subclasses, not a hardcoded model.
Added a simple in-memory index for tests, and an index reset method for reliable tests.
Added comprehensive pytest tests to cover adding, updating, and deleting across multiple models, and ignoring non-searchable models.
notes: Tests were added; run ./run_test.sh to execute. If running in this environment is not possible, run with Docker. output.json does not claim tests passed until executed locally or in CI. Indexing API uses (tablename, id) keys for in-memory test index; if a production search backend is used, adapt add_to_index/remove_from_index accordingly.
contract_changes: No change to method signatures, but the mixin now exposes register_listeners(db) and a test-only reset_index() method. Search return shapes unaffected; if the production search returns changed shapes, update documentation accordingly.
